management_steps.details: Life-threatening emergency. Correct any HGT < 4 mmol/L immediately. If HGT unavailable, treat empirically.

If awake & swallows: give oral glucose/sugar. If unable: give 1-2 ml/kg of 50% Dextrose IV/IO. In children: dilute to max 25% dextrose (2-4 ml/kg of 25% dextrose). Start 5-10% dextrose maintenance fluid.
Add IV Hydrocortisone (steroids) if refractory. If sulfonylurea overdose: give Octreotide. Ensure early NGT feeds in intubated patients.
